sources.title: Karar-4B · Open Turkish decision model, 4B, about 3 GB of RAM | JevAlt
sources.snippet: The best open-source Turkish decision model in its class, built by senior AI engineer Mert Kaya. Karar-4B scores 96.8% on held-out Turkish decisions against Kev-4B's 87.1%, and runs in about 3 GB of RAM.
